title: Finish manual command interception
scope: Add typed pre/post validation coverage to manual loader entrypoints that currently bypass it.
acceptance: Registry/manual entrypoint inventory names every covered or intentionally excluded call.
Permissive external-driver tests prove interception and version-1 layer compatibility.
evidence: PASS: cmake --build build-d3d12-baseline --config Release --target parallel-mater-manual-layer-tests parallel-mater-layer-validation-tests parallel-mater-loader-driver-discovery-tests --parallel 2; Windows GTX 1080 / MSBuild 18.9; all focused targets built.

PASS: ctest --test-dir build-d3d12-baseline -C Release -R parallel-mater-(generated-api-check|loader-|reject-|layer-|manual-) --output-on-failure; 13/13 passed, including typed manual interception and full ABI-v1 manual-call compatibility; tracked fixtures tests/api/manual_layer_interception_tests.cpp and tests/api/mock_manual_layer.cpp.
